note: Adapted from Ahmad's (1965) original species-level description, originally in English; it covers the imago and the soldier, with measurements in mm taken from his Table 22 (5 alates) and Table 23 (holotype soldier). Type locality Wang Nok An, Thailand, collected on 11 April 1962 (day 11, month 4) from the ground surface under leaf litter. The 13-segmented antennae are a rare character in this genus, and the author compared the species only with baluchistanicus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head smoky brown; postclypeus slightly paler than the head, anteclypeus whitish, labrum brownish, antennal segments yellow with brown, pronotum as dark as the head with a T-shaped pale yellow spot on the disc. Head and postclypeus with moderately long hairs, the anterior half of the labrum with sparse long hairs, the pronotum with many long setae and short hairs. Posterior half of the head semicircular, the sides parallel in front of the compound eyes; fontanelle plate not evident. Compound eyes nearly circular, separated from the lower margin of the head by half their short diameter; ocelli small, broadly oval, separated from the compound eye by their short diameter; postclypeus moderately arched, its length slightly less than half its width. Labrum broad, dome-shaped, wider than long. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum narrower than the head, its length slightly less than half its width; anterior margin slightly concave in the middle; posterior margin very weakly concave. Measurements of 5 alates (mm, mean in brackets): head length to the lateral antennal base 0.59—0.67 (0.63), head width 0.70—0.72 (0.70), compound eye long diameter 0.19—0.20 (0.19), short diameter 0.17—0.19 (0.17), compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.06—0.09 (0.08), ocellus 0.06—0.07 × 0.04—0.05, ocellus to compound eye 0.03—0.05 (0.04), postclypeus 0.15 × 0.36—0.39, pronotum 0.33—0.36 × 0.46—0.54 (0.50).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow with brown, postclypeus light brown, anteclypeus white, labrum brownish with a paler apex, antennae yellow with a darker scape, pronotum paler than the head, legs pale. Head with sparse hairs, the labrum with a few hairs anteriorly, the postmentum with a few hairs near the apex, the pronotum sparsely hairy. Head rectangular, its length about one and a half times its width; labrum about as long as wide, anterior margin nearly straight, sides slightly convex. Mandibles finely serrate, about half as long as the head, moderately incurved at the apex. Postmentum length slightly less than 3 times its anterior width, the waist at the basal third, nearer the posterior margin than the widest point. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 about twice segment 3 and 1.5 times segment 4. Pronotum weakly concave on both the anterior and the posterior margin. Measurements of the soldier (holotype) (mm): head length to the lateral antennal base 1.09, head width 0.67, head height 0.62, left mandible length 0.57, postmentum length 0.65, postmentum maximum width 0.24, minimum width 0.18, pronotum 0.26 × 0.44.
